items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story about 'Jim' (referred to as 'the old man') committing a crime at a club where the interviewee was performing. The interviewee states 'I had already called out there' and 'So I come on back out', indicating he was aware of Jim's actions and the situation, but there is

ctx.x: Oh, in bed. I see, yeah.

Jim walked on back to the car, went and got his .45 and come on back in there and she went to running and says, 'Oh, Jim, Jim, Jim, don't kill him. Don't kill him.' Well, in the meantime, Eddie had some brand new shoes he'd bought. He picked them shoes and clothes up and ran. See, the mountain goes right up, you know, and run up that mountain and so the old man was looking for Eddie and he's running all around there trying to find Eddie. He shot her.
